allocation_complete.reason: The BMS-relevant aspect (permitted discharge power) is covered by BMS_REQ_POWER_DERATING.

completeness.reason: The power is limited at the motor, while the requirement measures it at the drive axle within 5 %; how losses and the tolerance are handled is not addressed.
completeness.suggestion: State how the motor-side limit meets the drive-axle power within 5 % (driveline efficiency, measurement point).

consistency.reason: Consistent with bev sibling BB_POWER_LIMITS, whose permitted discharge power it applies.

design_clarity.reason: Chooses torque = power limit / motor speed and min(vehicle limit, BMS permitted power), but leaves the low-speed / standstill case (division by near-zero speed) unspecified.
design_clarity.suggestion: Specify the torque limit below a minimum motor speed (e.g. a speed floor or a maximum torque cap).

interface_only.reason: BMS_REQ_POWER_DERATING is a BMS interface need, allocated under bev exactly like the BMS needs exist.

no_value_copy.reason: No derating temperatures or power values restated.

parent_fit.reason: Limits the torque request so traction power stays at the vehicle limit (and BMS limit in bev), the core of REQ_TRACTION_POWER_LIMIT.

variant_consistency.reason: Ungated like its parent; the bev-only part sits in the variant function <<bev: BMS_REQ_POWER_DERATING>> of allocates; value referenced via the requirement.
